svg.title: A knee problem splits first on trauma: after an injury the mechanism and the swelling point to the structure, anterior cruciate ligament and meniscal tears from a pivot or twist on a planted foot, posterior cruciate, medial collateral and lateral collateral injuries from a blow; without trauma the site of the pain separates patellofemoral pain syndrome and knee bursitis in front, iliotibial band friction syndrome laterally and a popliteal cyst behind; each column gives presentation, the exam and workup, and treatment; the unhappy triad and knee injections are in panels
